description: Switching BadgeDisplayMode from Dot to Off on a launcher with no notifications prepares the Dot element as a small textless shape and hides the badge in Off mode.

assertions.comment: With no notification daemon and no unread notifications, the badge count is 0
The Dot badge width on the unnamed fixed child path is 9px, rounded from 18% of the 48px icon
Dot mode does not show numeric text in the unnamed badge Label
Even in Dot mode, the badge element is not visible when unread notifications are 0
Changing immediately to Off(2) keeps the unnamed badge element hidden
Off mode also hides the badge number Label
